title: Ultimate Breaks and Beats
hook: Every DJ you respect owned these 25 records.
voiceover: Every DJ you respect owned these 25 records. Ultimate Breaks and Beats. Street Beat Records, New York, 1986 to 1991, put together by Lenny Roberts and Breakbeat Lou. 25 volumes, catalog numbers SB-501 to SB-525. Each one is a compilation of the drum breaks DJs were cutting in the parks. Impeach the President, Apache, Funky Drummer, Amen, Brother, pressed loud on 1 record so you didn't have to carry the originals. Producers sampled straight off these, which is why so many 80s and 90s records share the same drums. Look for the cartoon cover art and the SB number on the label. Send this to the one friend who still buys vinyl.
caption: Crate Notes, week 1. Ultimate Breaks and Beats (Street Beat Records, 1986 to 1991), 25 volumes, SB-501 to SB-525, compiled by Lenny Roberts and Breakbeat Lou. The breaks DJs were cutting in the Bronx parks, pressed onto one record each. Half the drums on golden era rap were sampled straight off these. If you see the cartoon covers in a bin, buy them. Which volume do you own? 📦
